sourceDiscovery.workflow: Validate Artist Expansion YouTube recovery v3

rules: Machine discovery score or strong evidence never auto-approves a seed.
Approved rows require explicit canonical artist identity, exact video ID, reviewed video type, channel evidence, and source discovery provenance.
A video ID may not be approved for more than one canonical artist in this ledger.
Historical baseline video IDs and newly reviewed video IDs must remain disjoint.
Reviewed candidates do not modify youtube_seed_videos_v1.csv or Product ranking.
